title: The Filling of the Spirit
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The filling of the Spirit means living under the Spirit’s present influence, power, and direction. Believers are commanded to be filled with the Spirit rather than controlled by the flesh or worldly influences.
summary: The filling of the Spirit means living under the Spirit’s present influence, power, and direction. Believers are commanded to be filled with the Spirit rather than controlled by the flesh or worldly influences.
christFocus: The Spirit-filled life magnifies Christ through worship, thanksgiving, obedience, love, and faithful witness. The Spirit fills believers so their lives increasingly reflect the risen Lord.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Being filled with the Spirit is a command for believers. It is not merely an emotional moment or a private experience, but an ongoing life under the Spirit’s holy influence.

Ephesians contrasts being controlled by wine with being filled with the Spirit. The issue is control and direction. God’s people are not to be mastered by fleshly desires, but governed by the Spirit.

The filling of the Spirit produces worship, thanksgiving, humility, mutual service, courage, and obedience. In Acts, believers filled with the Spirit speak the Word with boldness and continue in joy amid opposition.

The filling of the Spirit is closely connected to the Word of Christ dwelling richly in believers. A Spirit-filled life is not detached from Scripture, worship, community, and submission to Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Some believers reduce the Spirit’s filling to a dramatic experience, while others ignore it altogether. Scripture calls God’s people to ongoing dependence, not either emotionalism or self-powered religion.

This doctrine matters because believers cannot live faithfully by empty resolve. They need the Spirit’s present power for worship, witness, endurance, and holy obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Father for the Spirit’s help and yield yourself to His rule. Turn from anything that controls your desires more than God does. Fill your mind with Scripture, worship with gratitude, serve humbly, and seek boldness to live and speak for Christ.
